_comment: Binding brand rules retrieved by retrieve_brand_style_guide. Merged in order: default <- content_types[type] <- matching topic_overlays.

default.citation_policy: Every factual claim carries an inline Markdown link to a primary or reputable source. Never cite a source you have not retrieved.

tutorial.citation_policy: Link to official documentation for every API or CLI command referenced. Version-pin all code samples.

case_study.citation_policy: Every metric must be attributed to a named, customer-approved source. Never estimate a customer result.

topic_overlays.citation_policy: Security claims require a primary source (CVE, NIST, vendor advisory, or standards body). Reputable-tier sources are insufficient on their own.
Every performance number must state the hardware, dataset and version it was measured on, and link to the published methodology.
Architecture designs must state failure domains, consistency models (CAP/PACELC), and link to official cloud provider or CNCF architecture patterns.
AI claims must link to primary benchmark datasets, peer-reviewed arXiv papers, or official model provider documentation.
Regulated-domain claims require a primary peer-reviewed or regulatory source, and the post must carry the standard 'not professional advice' disclaimer.
